    # Marker lattice is formed by rows with a dense non-background run and
    # columns with dense non-background runs. Pair adjacent sites into cells;
    # background marker color maps to 9.
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # each two marker columns are one output column; each marker row is one output row
    # colored repeated values in each pair indicate encoded color, absent(bg) => 9
    return [[(grid[r][cs[j]] if grid[r][cs[j]]!=bg else 9) for j in range(0,len(cs),2)] for r in rs[:-1]]
